Via press release quote: 'In January 2021, DCTA's Board of Directors awarded an on-demand service delivery contract to Via which allowed the agency to work with Via to develop a proposed service plan...On July 22, the board approved the GoZone service to launch on September 7 [2021].' Quote: 'A fleet of dedicated vans will be used to pick up and drop off riders at virtual stops within the zones' -- Turnkey inferred from 'on-demand service delivery contract' plus dedicated van fleet language (subsequent extensions confirm per-vehicle-hour billing, see later rows). GoZone launched 2021-09-07 in Denton and Lewisville/Highland Village zones, replacing several fixed routes and on-demand/Lyft programs. Signing Via legal entity not named in this release (later filings show River North Transit, LLC dba Via Transportation -- see FY2026 task-order row).

Community Impact (2023-09-28): DCTA board approved the first of two available one-year contract extensions with Via for GoZone (options under the 2021 award), extending service through 2024-09-30. Van service operations cost '$42.11 per hour'; total extension value $10.4 million (operations projected at over $9.8 million plus customer service costs of approximately $283,500 per six-month period). Status 'ended' because this specific one-year extension period (FY2024) has since lapsed and was superseded by the FY2025 and FY2026 actions below.
